title: WorldRecipe (format 1, W0 vocabulary)
description: Author-facing root generation document. Mirrors src/recipe/validate.ts, which is the enforced validator. Vocabulary through behavior 36: seed, named presets (size/climate/density), integer permille biases, budgets, toggles (none defined), decoration density, landmark requests with relational constraints or authored pins (at / near), per-recipe authored stamps, and sparse cell overrides. Remaining named-entity fields stay rejected until their milestones.

anyOf.description: a declared authoredStamps entry, namespaced recipe.<name>

at.description: pinned anchor cell; mutually exclusive with relation and near; fails generation with a named error rather than relocating

cell.description: [x, y] cell; must lie inside the size preset's world

near.description: constrained anchor search; mutually exclusive with relation and at

settlements.description: settlement constraints (behaviors 37-38): each entry claims one budget rank (explicit rank field, else its entry index) and places it by at or near; rank 0 is the capital; unclaimed ranks stay free-competed

at.description: pinned anchor cell; mutually exclusive with near; fails generation with a named error rather than relocating

cell.description: [x, y] cell; must lie inside the size preset's world

near.description: constrained anchor search; mutually exclusive with at

rank.description: explicit budget-slot claim (behavior 38); defaults to the entry index; effective ranks must be unique and below budgets.settlementCount

zones.description: zone composition (behavior 43): a grid of climate zones, each an additive character offset on the world climate; sea level stays a world choice

grid.description: [columns, rows]; required for grid layout, forbidden for anchors; world dimensions must divide evenly by each

seams.description: blended = climate gradient over the seam band; hard = sharp zone borders

anchor.description: anchor cell [x, y]; required for anchors layout

weight.description: territory weight (anchors layout); bigger claims more land; default 1000

elevationPermille.description: elevation character (behavior 46): strongly negative drowns the zone into sea; always blended at borders so coasts shelve

entries.description: one entry per zone in reading order (NW to SE); length must equal columns*rows

layout.description: grid (default): uniform tiling; anchors: weighted territories around authored anchor cells (behavior 45)

settlementStyle.description: settlement organics + variety (behavior 49): opt-in per-settlement size growth, center-to-rim scatter falloff, and purpose-flavored building mixes; absent means pre-49 fabric byte-for-byte

growthPermille.description: max extra settlement radius as a permille of base, rolled per settlement (squared roll; cities full, towns half, outposts never); lots and approach budgets scale with the grown area

scatterPermille.description: structure acceptance falls linearly from the plaza to 1000-scatterPermille at the rim, and the fabric footprint extends by the same fraction; civic specials always place

variety.description: purpose-flavored specials and fill from the expanded roster: warehouses/fisher huts (harbor), quarries (mining), windmills (farming), watermills (crossing), stores/guardhouses/tents

organicStreets.description: lived-in streets (behavior 50): worn packed-earth lane fragments instead of solid cobble approaches for ordinary houses, roadless fringe houses, varied yards, asymmetric street arms, cottages at depth

authoredStamps.description: One-off per-recipe stamps (behavior 36). Each stamp is a full stampFormat-1 definition whose type must be recipe.<name>; it passes exactly the fixture library's parser checks.

cellOverrides.description: Sparse designer spot decisions (behavior 36), applied after every procedural pass and before validation. At least one of material/clearProp/clearDecal per entry; water materials refused (hydrology owns water); duplicate cells refused; soft cap 64 (warn-only).

cell.description: [x, y] cell; must lie inside the size preset's world
